“患者是什么情况？”

临川市精神病院、俗称二院的走廊里，林舒一边翻着之前的采访记录，一边向一旁的医生询问。

按道理来说，像他这样的不知名小媒体的小记者，是不可能直接来到精神病院里来做采访的。

但奈何他有个好人脉----这个叫谢雨迟的医生是他从小到大的发小，感情很深，为了他那岌岌可危的事业，也愿意在一些非原则性的问题上开一盏绿灯。

左手拿着病例，谢雨迟右手快速签下自己的名字，紧接着回答道：

“患者是一个梅山派的师公----师公你知道是什么吧？”

“师公？”

林舒愣了一愣。

他对“师公”这个职业其实并不陌生，尤其是在自己从小长大的少数民族聚居区，师公这个角色，其实是渗透进了生活的方方面面的。

看阳宅、寻阴宅要找师公，逢年过节祭祀祈福要找师公，遇上倒霉的事情要找师公化解，甚至哪怕是鱼刺卡了喉咙，不去医院、反而去找师公的也大有人在。

----说到卡鱼刺这事儿，林舒自己还真经历过。

当年他妈妈被鱼刺卡了喉咙，也是去找的师公“化水”，一碗符水下去，鱼刺还真就没了。

后来林舒也去了解过，这道法术被称为“九龙化水术”，在梅山派里很常见。

至于是不是有效.......对一个唯物主义者来说，林舒还是更倾向于，那是一种强心理暗示，至于师公嘛，大部分也是“主动或者被动”地装神弄鬼。

所以，这次闹出大问题的这个患者，就是一个“狂信到发疯”的师公？

略微收回散乱的思绪，林舒点头回答道：

“师公我知道的----所以之前他干的那些事情，跟宗教信仰有关？”

“关系很大。”

谢雨迟回答得很精简，而林舒则是皱起了眉头。

“那麻烦就大了......我本来还以为是个普通的精神病人，但如果掺杂了宗教的话，那我就不好往外报了......”

“你报不报，现在舆情都已经偏向这方面了。”

谢雨迟耸了耸肩。

“一轻伤两重伤，而且现场那么诡异，消息早就压不住了。”

“你刷刷抖音看呗，上面全都是在猜是邪教祭祀的。”

“这肯定是个大爆点，就看你有没有本事绕过审核红线了----你是干这行的，总不能我来教你吧？”

“确实。”

林舒暗暗思索，这案子其实也不是没有顺利报道的方法，无非就是先用“邪教”来吸引眼球，最后用科学解释过程，参考“走近科学”的老路罢了。

步骤是多了点，审核红线也密了点，但只要能爆出来，搞不好就会成为现象级的流量。

到时候，自己下半年的奖金就不愁了.......

想到这里，林舒果断下了决心。

“走吧，先去见见----他没什么危险吧？”

“没有。”

谢雨迟摇头道：

“他是一个非常自洽的患者，基本没有攻击性，不过我没办法给你安排房间，你就到他病房门口，隔着门跟他对话好了。”

“没问题。”

林舒跟在谢雨迟身后，两人稍稍加快了脚步。

二院的布局跟其他所有精神病院都是一样的，一条长长的走廊，两边是合金制造的坚固的房门，门上开有观察窗，观察窗正对着床，方便观察病人的情况。

一般来说，重症病人都是被用束缚带绑在床上的。

但相对轻症、或者自洽、没有自残自伤倾向的病人，基本都是被放养的。

就像他们现在看到的这个、名叫徐长顺的病人。

“长顺！”

谢雨迟隔着房门叫了一声，一个男人从床上坐了起来。

“哎，谢医生！”

他的脸出现在观察窗前----那是一张完全符合林舒对“师公”的刻板印象的脸。

干瘦、棱角分明、颧骨高耸。

头发花白，束在脑后，整个人带着几分仙风道骨的气韵，但又隐含着一丝黑暗的、令人战栗的冷气。

“谢医生.......这位是？”

“我朋友，一个记者，你叫小陈就好了，他想了解了解你的事情。”

谢雨迟回答得相当坦然，她完全没有向徐长顺隐瞒的意思。

“哦......那咱就站着谈？抱歉啊，后生，这里规矩是这样的.......”

“没事，没事。”

林舒连忙回答。

就像谢雨迟说的一样，他从徐长顺的身上确实看不到什么攻击性----那种第一眼看到时感受到的冷气，其实大多数是来自于他所属的那个“梅山教”本身的冷意。

“你想问什么呢？”

徐长顺主导着谈话的节奏，但并没有展现太多压迫感。

“我想问问案发的前因后果----方便吗？”

“哎.......”

徐长顺叹了口气，眼神中流露出几分懊悔。

“没什么不方便的，说出来，我自己还好受点。”

“其实，我真的很后悔。”

后悔？

“后悔什么？”

“后悔伤了那三个人.......我也在谢医生那里看过现在网上的评价了，都说我是要拿活人献祭什么的。”

徐长顺摇着头。

“但其实不是那样的......我们梅山派，哪有什么活人献祭的法术啊？”

“梅山派本来就是个......以耕、猎为基础发展起来的教派，我们的法术都是跟农事、猎事相关的，哪里会那么黑......”

"What's the condition of the patient?"

In the corridor of Linchuan Mental Hospital, commonly known as the Second Hospital, Lin Shu asked the doctor beside him while flipping through the records of previous interviews.

Logically speaking, it is impossible for a small reporter from an unknown small media like him to come directly to a mental hospital to conduct interviews.

But he has good connections - this doctor named Xie Yuchi has been his childhood friend and has deep feelings. For the sake of his precarious career, he is also willing to give a green light on some non-principled issues.

Holding the case in his left hand, Xie Yuchi quickly signed his name with his right hand, and then replied:

"The patient is a master from the Meishan sect—master, do you know what he is?"

"Master?"

Lin Shu was stunned for a moment.

He is actually no stranger to the profession of "master", especially in the minority-inhabited area where he grew up. The role of master has penetrated into all aspects of life.

You have to go to your master to see the yangzhai or the yin house, you have to go to your master to pray for blessings during festivals, you have to go to your master to resolve any unlucky things, and even if a fish bone gets stuck in your throat, there are a lot of people who don't go to the hospital but go to your master instead.

----Speaking of fish bone stuck, Lin Shu has actually experienced it himself.

Back then, his mother had a fish bone stuck in her throat, so she went to see her master to "transform it into water". When she poured a bowl of talisman water into it, the fish bones were gone.

Later, Lin Shu also learned about it. This spell was called the "Nine Dragons Water Transformation Technique" and was very common in the Meishan Sect.

As for whether it is effective... For a materialist, Lin Shu still prefers it. It is a strong psychological suggestion. As for the master, most of them are "actively or passively" pretending to be gods and ghosts.

So, the patient who caused the big problem this time is a master who is "crazy enough to believe in himself"?

After slightly recovering his scattered thoughts, Lin Shu nodded and replied:

"I know about Master——so the things he did before were related to religious beliefs?"

"It's a big deal."

Xie Yuchi answered concisely, while Lin Shu frowned.

"Then it would be a big trouble...I originally thought he was an ordinary mental patient, but if it is mixed with religion, then it would be difficult for me to report it..."

"Whether you report it or not, public opinion has already shifted in this direction."

Xie Yuchi shrugged.

"One was slightly injured and two were seriously injured, and the scene was so weird that the news could not be suppressed for a long time."

"Just scroll through Douyin and watch. Everyone on it is guessing that it's a cult sacrifice."

"This must be a big breaking point. It depends on whether you have the ability to bypass the review red line - you are in this industry, you can't let me teach you, right?"

"Indeed."

Lin Shu secretly thought that there was actually no way to successfully report this case. It was nothing more than using "cult" to attract attention first, and finally using science to explain the process, following the old path of "approaching science".

There are a lot of steps, and the audit red lines are a little tighter, but as long as it can be exposed, it may become a phenomenon-level traffic.

By then, I won’t have to worry about my bonus for the second half of the year...

Thinking of this, Lin Shu made a decisive decision.

"Let's go and see him first - he's not in any danger, is he?"

"No."

Xie Yuchi shook his head and said:

"He is a very self-consistent patient and basically not aggressive. However, I can't arrange a room for you. Just go to the door of his ward and talk to him through the door."

"No problem."

Lin Shu followed Xie Yuchi, and the two of them quickened their pace slightly.

The layout of the Second Hospital is the same as that of all other mental hospitals. There is a long corridor with solid doors made of alloy on both sides. There is an observation window on the door. The observation window is facing the bed, making it easier to observe the patient's condition.

Generally speaking, critically ill patients are tied to the bed with restraints.

However, patients with relatively mild symptoms, or who are self-consistent and have no tendency to harm themselves are basically left alone.

Just like the patient they are seeing now named Xu Changshun.

"Changshun!"

Xie Yuchi called through the door, and a man sat up from the bed.

"Hey, thank you doctor!"

His face appeared in front of the observation window - it was a face that completely fit Lin Shu's stereotype of "Master".

Thin, angular, with high cheekbones.

His hair is gray and tied back, and his whole person has a somewhat fairy-like aura, but it also contains a hint of dark, chilling air-conditioning.

"Doctor Xie...who is this?"

"My friend is a reporter. Just call me Xiao Chen. He wants to know more about you."

Xie Yuchi answered quite frankly. She had no intention of hiding anything from Xu Changshun.

"Oh...Then let's talk standing up? Sorry, junior, this is the rule here..."

"It's okay, it's okay."

Lin Shu answered quickly.

Just like Xie Yuchi said, he really didn't see any aggression in Xu Changshun - the coldness he felt when he first saw him was actually mostly from the coldness of the "Meishan Sect" to which he belonged.

"What do you want to ask?"

Xu Changshun dominated the rhythm of the conversation, but did not show too much oppression.

"I would like to ask about the cause and effect of the crime - is it convenient?"

"Hey..."

Xu Changshun sighed, with a bit of regret in his eyes.

"It's nothing inconvenient. Just saying it makes me feel better."

"Actually, I really regret it."

Regret?

"What do you regret?"

"I regret hurting those three people... I also read the reviews online from Dr. Xie. They all said that I wanted to sacrifice human beings or something."

Xu Changshun shook his head.

"But it's not like that... How can our Meishan sect have any human sacrifice magic?"

"Meishan Sect is originally a sect... developed based on farming and hunting. Our spells are all related to farming and hunting. How can it be so dark..."
